paragraphs.text: Avizoa is an obsolete creature type for cards that represent a species of flying jellyfish native to Dominaria .

Avizoa was introduced in Weatherlight on the eponymous Avizoa card. During the Magic Online digital release of Weatherlight, just before the Grand Creature Type Update , the type was given errata to just be Jellyfish. As the card is on the Reserved List , it has never been reprinted with its new type line.
Thus far, Avizoa have only appeared on Dominaria, though the similar Esperzoa and Gomazoa can be found Alara and Zendikar , respectively.

Avizoa appear to be large floating jellyfish that move through the skies of Dominaria. Similar to their sea-based counterparts, they have a gelatinous upper body with various tentacles coming down from it. Their tentacles are strong enough to grab and lift humans . Tahngarth once thought to trap Avizoa with bait, thinking to use Squee as the bait. Nael is a Yavimayan elf scout known as the Avizoa Aeronaut who uses Avizoa to fly by attaching a bucket to them, similar to a hot air balloon. During her travels, she once noticed a flock of avizoa floating in the sky, and after several failed experiments, she found herself soaring above the clouds alongside them, getting a view of Dominaria that few get a chance to appreciate.
